summary.en: A full-width band of light hops row to row on a still capture; each row brings its own value, line and note into the margin, level with it, and is ringed.
summary.zh: 一条整行的光带在静止截图上逐行跳动；每一行带来自己的数值、说明和注释，与它齐平地写在页边，并被圈出。

fits: A table, a list or a paragraph whose rows each carry a point (benchmark rows, plan tiers, guide steps).
notFor: More than four rows (cut to the ones that matter); rows too close to tell apart at rest.

intent.en: The viewer reads a real table one row at a time, each row paired with the sentence it proves.
intent.zh: 观众一行一行地读真实表格，每行都配着它所证明的那句话。

content.en: A capture with 2–4 row regions (band and box each); per row a value (≤ 10 chars / 5 字), a line (≤ 18 / 14 字), a note (≤ 40 / 22 字).
content.zh: 一张带 2–4 个行区域（各有整行和方框）的截图；每行一个数值（≤ 10 字符 / 5 字）、一行说明（≤ 18 / 14 字）、一条注释（≤ 40 / 22 字）。

fits.zh: 每行都有一个要点的表格、列表或段落（基准测试行、价格档、操作步骤）。

notFor.zh: 超过四行（只留重要的）；静止时分不清的紧挨着的行。

pairs.note: push onto the last row as the claim

en: Each row’s copy leaves as the next hop starts; do not keep two rows’ words on screen.
zh: 下一次跳动开始时上一行的文案退场；不要同时留两行的字。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
